principles.status: Feature definitions/crosswalk considered; no positive implementation from a principle mapping alone.

scope_choices: Targeted 2026-11-22 review resolved remaining visual-inventory and bibliography-entry gaps on the same hash-pinned PDF. Prior text/visual work is reused with original attribution; details and actual new page receipts are in verification.json. Bibliographies were read as entries only; cited full texts and external videos/code were not inspected.
